decisions.reason: As a multi-model dental line with an explicit launch commitment and a close fit to the firm's core laboratory workflow business, management is likely to continue backing it after several years rather than reverse course.
This thermoforming blank sits squarely in the firm's core materials offering and earlier dedicated promotion signals investment that escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to abandon.

Although this lacquer is a less prominent accessory product and therefore more disposable than the core lines, management would still be inclined to keep it unless weakness became unmistakable and not explainable as portfolio support.
A custom earmold line draws directly on the firm's established custom-device capabilities, hearing-care channels, and production know-how, which supports continued commitment.
Custom hearing protection earmolds are a credible adjacent extension of the firm's earmold competence, so prior investment and strategic fit make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.
